title: ficus drupacea var. pubescens
intro: Ficus drupacea var. pubescens, commonly known as the beech fig, is a plant species in the family Moraceae. It is a deciduous tree native to Southeast Asia, known for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits. The beech fig has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects and potential health benefits.
